rule_role: Reference-level prohibitions and interpretation obligations, not production policy engine

rules.rule: Every canonical concept has exactly one X/Y/Z primary definition home
T/F/M/O are not new primary ontology homes
Exactly five X dimensions; each has exactly one Scope and exactly two complementary endpoints
Actor, Role Binding, Principal, Session Binding and Capability Profile are not interchangeable
Capability and Role Binding do not grant Authority
Admission is a concrete request gate; neither visible information nor a selected Action establishes Admission
Only admitted Core ingestion changes canonical Thread state
Result, Outcome, Completion, Verification, Conclusion and Satisfaction are distinct
Artifact and Evidence do not automatically become verified truth
A subject-qualified claim/hypothesis is a Y Annotation; a freestanding thesis may be Y Content
Referent binding requires a compatible, identified instance and declared resolution context
X dimensions Ψ/Γ/Σ/Ξ/Π are non-instantiable viewpoints; X:α:Σ["q"] invalid
Distinct occurrence, recording, observation, assessment and validity time roles must not collapse
Chronology and logical clock partial order do not establish causation
Available != permitted != delivered != perceived != concluded
Projection, compression and summary may be lossy; do not imply complete historical reconstruction
Bidirectional navigation does not imply symmetric or invertible predicate
Typed path composition does not infer a new relationship predicate
An internally valid proof is distinct from trusted premises or independently verified external truth
Missing authority => refuse effect; unsupported inference => not-established, not empirically false
Loose/Transitional/Strict are illustrative VG interpretive labels, not authorized runtime MODE values
Alpha/Beta/Zeta descriptions must preserve O/T witnesses rather than erasing historical qualification
Morphology coordinates are not a numeric ML feature space by default
Metric, nominal, ordinal, interval and ratio semantic constraints remain separate from epistemic trust and permission
Changed parameter/revision alone does not prove changed effect; require activation and effect path
Foreign IDs are not authenticated local Principals; foreign mappings may lose information but must disclose it
A Canonical Thread is not a Relay Thread or a runtime session; no automatic promotion
Visual anchor identity does not prove concept/instance identity, truth, Admission or schema contract
Cache availability/fingerprint does not prove freshness or current Authorization
An admissible formula or function discovery is not permission to execute an effectful Tool
Do not use NFKC-folded glyphs as machine identifiers
No automatic legacy Thread migration or real production conformance implied
